title: Snap! Build Your Own Blocks
byline: Bernat Romagosa, Michael Ball, Jens Mönig, Brian Harvey, Jadge Hügle
excerpt: The Snap! Community. Snap! is a blocks-based programming language built by UC Berkeley and used by hundreds of thousands of programmers around the world.
content_html:
Snap! is a broadly inviting programming language for kids and adults that's also a platform for serious study of computer science.

Run Now Example Projects Learn Snap!
